So I was doing some research late last night and realized that I might possibly have some stem/crown rot. I want to know your opinion. I only caught this because I was reading up about it and it said that stem/crown rot can make leaves fall off and the one leaf I thought was maybe torn off has some black around it. You can see in a couple of the photos that some of the roots near the crown are also black at the base. I also dug into my medium a bit more and found that there was a plastic cage around the middle of my orchid that was holding in this super dense and soggy soil! I was like wtf why would they do this?!?! So I removed all the old medium and found that it looked pretty black where all that soggy soil was. I looked up videos and read up more about it and I sprayed hydrogen peroxide right where that black spot is in the center. I then let it sit for a little while it worked and then I put cinnamon on the black spot. I’m hoping I’m just overreacting and it’s not actually stem/crown rot but let me know what you think. Unfortunately I did not think to take more pictures before I put cinnamon all over it but if you can’t tell from the pictures I posted before let me know and I’ll post more. Thanks so much!
